# Cohort 83: scalar-template selected construction and run seed

The scalar descriptor fixture keeps its existing native selected store, but
no longer returns a database handle beside it. SQLite's exact supplied context
and native constructor are unchanged. PostgreSQL consumes the existing native
fixture constructor instead of a raw harness and reconstructed store. The
run seed consumes the promoted original lifecycle/completion role.

The descriptor wrapper only retains its deliberate descriptor response/error
faults; it does not recover pools or introduce another coordinator. The same
canonical admitted artifact, source hash, origin, run ID and timestamp enter
RequireRun. Existing flow construction is untouched.

Two finite snapshots permit only those owner substitutions. The unchanged
both-store race journey retains every scoped/keyed descriptor selection,
descriptor drift/error, duplicate short-circuit, conflicting event refusal,
persisted target readback and committed-route replay assertion. This file has
no remaining database/sql import, raw getter, dialect seed or raw pool return.
No new port, semantic policy, framework, compatibility path, spec or tracking
change is introduced. Broader #2542 raw fixture debt remains open.
